theorems.name: Submission.dor_lmbsf_pc_coarea_glue
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (Z : Set (Euclid (n + 1))) (Zs : ℕ → Set (Euclid (n + 1))) (ψ : Euclid (n + 1) → Euclid P) (F : Euclid (n + 1) → ℝ) (φ g : Euclid P → ℝ≥0∞), ContinuousOn ψ Z → InjOn ψ Z → Measurable F → (∀ q, MeasurableSet (Zs q)) → Pairwise (fun p q => Disjoint (Zs p) (Zs q)) → (⋃ q, Zs q) = Z → (∀ q, AEMeasurable (fun t : ℝ => ∫⁻ x in ψ '' (Zs q ∩ F ⁻¹' {t}), φ x ∂μHE[n]) ∧ ∫⁻ t : ℝ, (∫⁻ x in ψ '' (Zs q ∩ F ⁻¹' {t}), φ x ∂μHE[n]) = ∫⁻ x in ψ '' Zs q, g x ∂μHE[n + 1]) → AEMeasurable (fun t : ℝ => ∫⁻ x in ψ '' (Z ∩ F ⁻¹' {t}), φ x ∂μHE[n]) ∧ ∫⁻ t : ℝ, (∫⁻ x in ψ '' (Z ∩ F ⁻¹' {t}), φ x ∂μHE[n]) = ∫⁻ x in ψ '' Z, g x ∂μHE[n + 1]
